insight: Ranked #1 in Meta's 2026 audio source-separation benchmark; splits finished masters into up to 14 instrument stems.
name: AudioShake
tagline: AI audio separation that splits any track into clean instrument stems.
description: AudioShake uses AI to separate finished recordings into clean, performance-quality stems — vocals, drums, bass, guitar, and more — plus dialogue/music/effects splits and word-synced lyric transcription. It is offered as the Indie web app for artists, Live for studios, and a REST API/SDK for developers. Major labels and studios use it for remixing, dubbing, and remastering.
